_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: one shape lands on the other half; 2: lines or several shapes fold over and must line up; 3: letters that flip, or lines that join up into new shapes. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
